I21.9.clinical_criteria: Requires documented elevation of cardiac biomarkers (troponin I/T) above 99th percentile with ischemic symptoms, characteristic ECG ST-T wave changes, or pathological Q waves. Cannot be assigned if troponins are strictly negative and ischemia is ruled out.

K21.9.clinical_criteria: Clinical symptom complex of heartburn, acid regurgitation, or non-cardiac retrosternal chest pain responsive to proton pump inhibitors or confirmed by endoscopy.

K80.20.description: Calculus of gallbladder without cholecystitis without obstruction
K80.20.clinical_criteria: Ultrasound demonstration of gallstones (cholelithiasis) with recurrent biliary colic symptoms warranting elective or emergency cholecystectomy.

Z41.1.chapter: Factors influencing health status and contact with health services
Z41.1.clinical_criteria: Elective aesthetic modification or cosmetic rhinoplasty performed for personal appearance without documented acute structural trauma or reconstructive defect.

J18.9.clinical_criteria: Fever, cough, sputum production with confirmatory pulmonary consolidation or infiltrates on chest imaging.

S82.101A.description: Unspecified fracture of upper end of right tibia, initial encounter for closed fracture
S82.101A.chapter: Injury, poisoning and certain other consequences of external causes
S82.101A.clinical_criteria: Documented acute radiological evidence of proximal tibial fracture requiring reduction, internal fixation, or casting.

E11.9.clinical_criteria: Elevated fasting blood glucose or HbA1c >= 6.5% under ongoing medical management.
